landing.badge: Pure frontend · Bring your own key · No server relay
landing.heroTitle: One contract, driving multi-provider multimodal generation
landing.heroDescription: AI Media SDK unifies the calling contract for image and video generation across Azure OpenAI, Alibaba Bailian (DashScope), Volcengine Ark (Seedream) and MiniMax (Hailuo Video). Enter your own API keys on this site and experience generation and editing directly in your browser.

image.title: Image generation & editing
image.description: A unified entry for text-to-image and image-to-image; reference-image editing with multi-model parameters.

video.title: Video generation
video.description: Text-to-video, first-frame-to-video, reference-to-video and video editing, with in-browser polling of async tasks.

local.title: Local-first experience
local.description: Hash-based reuse of local image caches; results can be auto-saved to a directory you choose.

privacy.title: Privacy & key notes
privacy.keys: Your API keys are stored only in your browser's localStorage and sent directly to the corresponding provider — never through an intermediate server.
privacy.cache: Locally uploaded images are cached only in your browser, deduplicated by content hash, and encoded only when sent.
privacy.temporary: Results come from temporary provider URLs and may expire; optionally auto-save them to a local directory.
privacy.autoSave: Auto-save relies on the File System Access API; the latest Chrome or Edge is recommended.
